decision.reason: The user asked to cut a release once the open PRs merged: the comicCredit setting and the 'What it adds to your PR' notice the Anthropic directory asked for (#218), fresh review passes superseding earlier ones (#220), linked-worktree run folders (#217), dependencies:prepare fixes (#221), the Showtail leak-scan pin (#222), README updates (#216, #224) and the compatibility results (#137). The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
